categories.name: وَزْنُ فَاعِلٍ
categories.nameEn: Active participles on the pattern fāʿil (فاعل) in the Qur'an

items.verseEn: Say, "Yes, and you will be [rendered] contemptible."

items.verse: وَقَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ ٱئْتُونِى بِكُلِّ سَـٰحِرٍ عَلِيمٍۢ
items.verseEn: And Pharaoh said, "Bring to me every learned magician."

items.verse: رَبِّ فَلَا تَجْعَلْنِى فِى ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
items.verseEn: My Lord, then do not place me among the wrongdoing people."

items.verse: قَالُوا۟ بَشَّرْنَـٰكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ فَلَا تَكُن مِّنَ ٱلْقَـٰنِطِينَ
items.verseEn: They said, "We have given you good tidings in truth, so do not be of the despairing."

categories.name: أَفْعَالٌ مَاضِيَةٌ بِصِيغَةِ الْمُتَكَلِّمِينَ (نَا الْفَاعِلِينَ)
categories.nameEn: Past tense verbs in the first person plural (we) form

items.verse: فَلَمَّآ ءَاسَفُونَا ٱنتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ فَأَغْرَقْنَـٰهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
items.verseEn: And when they angered Us, We took retribution from them and drowned them all.
So We saved him and his family, all,

items.verse: إِلَّا ٱمْرَأَتَهُۥ قَدَّرْنَآ ۙ إِنَّهَا لَمِنَ ٱلْغَـٰبِرِينَ
items.verseEn: Except his wife." We [i.e., Allāh] decreed that she is of those who remain behind.

items.verse: ثُمَّ بَعَثْنَا مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ رُسُلًا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِمْ فَجَآءُوهُم بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ فَمَا كَانُوا۟ لِيُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِمَا كَذَّبُوا۟ بِهِۦ مِن قَبْلُ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَطْبَعُ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِ ٱلْمُعْتَدِينَ
items.verseEn: Then We sent after him messengers to their peoples, and they came to them with clear proofs. But they were not to believe in that which they had denied before. Thus We seal over the hearts of the transgressors.

categories.name: اِسْمُ مَفْعُولٍ بِصِيغَةِ جَمْعِ الْمُذَكَّرِ السَّالِمِ
categories.nameEn: Passive participles in the sound masculine plural form in the Qur'an

items.verseEn: And they denied him, so indeed, they will be brought [for punishment],
Except the chosen servants of Allāh.

items.verse: قَالُوا۟ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهِ يَـٰنُوحُ لَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْمَرْجُومِينَ
items.verseEn: They said, "If you do not desist, O Noah, you will surely be of those who are stoned."

items.verse: فَلَا تَدْعُ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَـٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَتَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُعَذَّبِينَ
items.verseEn: So do not invoke with Allāh another deity and [thus] be among the punished.

items.verse: فَأَسْرِ بِأَهْلِكَ بِقِطْعٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلَّيْلِ وَٱتَّبِعْ أَدْبَـٰرَهُمْ وَلَا يَلْتَفِتْ مِنكُمْ أَحَدٌۭ وَٱمْضُوا۟ حَيْثُ تُؤْمَرُونَ
items.verseEn: So set out with your family during a portion of the night and follow behind them and let not anyone among you look back and continue on to where you are commanded."
Then have you considered if We gave them enjoyment for years
And indeed, you pass by them in the morning
And they believed, so We gave them enjoyment [of life] for a time.
